title: RoKingdom
description: RoKingdom. A world to build, fight, and create.
body:
# 👑 RoKingdom | Ultimate Creative & Survival SMP

Welcome to **RoKingdom**, a premier Minecraft network tailored for both master builders and survival enthusiasts. We offer two distinct, professionally managed game modes designed to give you the ultimate sandbox experience. 

Choose your path below—whether you want to design masterpieces with limitless resources or forge a legacy alongside a great community.

---

## 🎨 Game Mode 1: Creative Build Mode

Unleash your imagination without boundaries. Our Creative realm is optimized for builders who want a smooth, feature-rich environment to design, collaborate, and showcase their architectural skills.

* **Massive Creative Plots** – Claim your own space or merge plots with friends to build massive projects without interruption.
* **Advanced Building Tools** – Access to powerful tools and plugins to streamline your builds and bring complex designs to life effortlessly.
* **Inspiration & Collaboration** – Join a community of talented artists, share feedback, and participate in regular server-wide build contests.

---

## ⚔️ Game Mode 2: Survival SMP

For those who crave adventure, organic community growth, and standard progression. Our Survival SMP offers a classic, pure multiplayer experience backed by a balanced, player-driven ecosystem.

* **Pure Survival Experience** – Play the game the way it was meant to be played. Explore, build, and survive in a shared world with an emphasis on trust and community cooperation.
* **Player-Driven Economy** – Set up shops, trade rare resources, and dominate the server marketplace to build your financial empire.
* **Community & Events** – Engage in an active, welcoming community featuring custom staff-hosted events, challenges, and competitive leaderboards.

---

## 🚀 Why Play on RoKingdom?

* **Optimized Performance** – 24/7 uptime running on high-end dedicated hardware ensures a completely lag-free experience across both game modes.
* **Fair Play Environment** – Our mature, dedicated staff team actively maintains a toxic-free and balanced community.

---

## 🎮 How to Join

* **Website:** [www.rokingdom.com](http://www.rokingdom.com)
* **Server IP:** `play.rokingdom.com`
